# Kelikuli — Resin Toy & Figurine Factory

> Kelikuli is a B2B resin toy and figurine manufacturer based in Zhejiang, China. We offer wholesale, custom OEM/ODM resin figurines, blind box series, seasonal decorations, and collectibles.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kelikuli.com/): Factory overview, featured products, and inquiry entry.
- [Products](https://kelikuli.com/products): Full wholesale product catalog with category filters.
- [Custom OEM/ODM](https://kelikuli.com/custom-oem-odm): Custom design, mold-making, and OEM/ODM services.
- [News](https://kelikuli.com/news): Industry insights, new product launches, and company updates.
- [About Us](https://kelikuli.com/about-us): Factory background, certifications, and production capabilities.
- [Contact](https://kelikuli.com/contact): Inquiry form, WhatsApp, WeChat, and email contact.
